selection_population: Two validation trip IDs with smallest SHA256(20261118:<trip_id>) per each tuning64 whole-trip fold; six unique trips total
fold_estimator_rule: Every selected route uses only its own validation fold model trained on the other tuning64 folds; direct-refitted v1 baseline uses exact same train/validation IDs and float64 precision
calibration_policy: Fixed physical sigma_m=7.5 and beta values below, not fitted from any route or all80; no reference enters matching

candidate_policy.empty_candidate_fallback: Inherited v1 radius doubling only when no candidate; K remains capped at12

transition_cost_definition: cheap path_cost_slack_m is a fixed physical deadband max(abs(network-chord)-slack_m,0)/beta; finite reachability is never changed. Stationary penalties apply only at chord<=3m; no path repair or additional routing.
constraints: No actual model fits or raw TRAIN route decoding by this worker.
Lead must freeze model-candidate menu and explicitly authorize raw TRAIN decoding in PROTOCOL.json.
Every failed/worse trial is retained; failure contributes zero primary/tie metric.
Original proxy labels, canonical edge policy, route overlap metrics and v1 FEATURE_VERSION remain unchanged.
K24, observation intervals1/3/5 with distance5/10 are distribution-policy experiments deferred from actual first-pass selection; synthetic tests may demonstrate their behavior.
No likelihood comparison across candidate sets; no reference-guided repair, global deduplication or route hardcoding.
No confirmation/student/evaluator access or selection; historical all80 in-sample model is not paired baseline.
